identity.title: The Lesson of the Sandy Fist
identity.description: I'd like to observe you putting your new weapon to use, my young student. This will aid me in determining what degree of training will be best suited to your talents.$B$BWe have many training targets in the training grounds below. Practice your attacks upon them, and return to me once you're feeling comfortable with your new weapon.

Progress.english: The training targets are just down the hill. Come back to me once you're finished.

zhCN.text: 训练沙袋就在山坡下。练习完成后就来找我吧。

zhTW.text: 訓練目標就在小丘下面。完成後便即刻回來見我。

Completion.english: Not bad, $n. You may indeed have chosen the proper path.$B$BGood. Let us continue.

zhCN.text: 干得不错，$n。你的确选择了正确的道路。$B$B很好。我们继续吧。

zhTW.text: 不壞，$n。或許你終究選擇了正確的道路。$B$B很好。讓我們繼續下去。

identity.title: The Lesson of Stifled Pride
identity.objectives: Defeat 6 Huojin Trainees or Tushui Trainees.
identity.description: Facing a living opponent is a very different thing from the stationary targets in the yard. Living opponents strike back. There is the very real fear of failure, and sometimes, even death.$B$BYou must have the courage to overcome those fears.$B$BChallenge the other trainees within the temple or down the steps below, and defeat them.

Progress.english: There is a time for meditation and contemplation, and there is a time for action. Diving the balance between the two is one of the greatest wisdoms we seek.

zhCN.text: 有时，我们需要沉思冥想；有时，我们则需要果断行动。两者间的平衡发展就是我们所追求的最高境界。

zhTW.text: 有時需要冥想沉思，有時也要奮起而行。兩者之間的平衡取捨是我們所追求的大智慧之一。

Completion.english: Intriguing, my young pupil.$B$BMost of the other trainees have been here for quite some time, but you are able to match them even within this first hour.$B$BThis speaks well of you, but there are yet other lessons I would see you learn.

zhCN.text: 很不错，我年轻的徒弟。$B$B这里的其他徒弟大多经过了长时间的训练，而你接受训练的时间还不到一小时，却能够击败他们。$B$B这值得赞扬，但我还有其他东西要教给你。

zhTW.text: 真令人印象深刻!$B$B其他受訓弟子大多在此待了一段時間，但你剛來一個時辰便勝過了他們。$B$B你表現得很好，但是我仍需要你進行其他的修行。
